primitive: Provide request-scoped server deadline and cancellation middleware that propagates cancellation into route tasks.
evidence: scripts/agent/jet-env jet check /home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/area-backend/timeout_probe.jet -> Error [E1004]: `core.http.server` has no item `timeout`; the available list contains bind/mux/serve/shutdown-adjacent serving helpers but no timeout wrapper. The HTTP reference also marks server timeout middleware open at docs/reference/core-library.md:753.
workaround: Use client-side phase timeouts and manual time checks; graceful server shutdown works, but an in-flight handler cannot be cancelled by a server policy.
